summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income filed an Item 8.01 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting only its monthly net asset value determination as of September 30, 2026, prepared under board-approved valuation guidelines by advisor Inland InPoint Advisor, LLC. Aggregate NAV attributable to common stock was $136.483 million across 10,122 thousand shares, yielding aggregate NAV per share of $13.4838. Assets included $301.1 million commercial mortgage loans, $153.6 million real estate owned, and $37.1 million cash; liabilities included $201.3 million repurchase agreements and $88.6 million preferred stock. No transaction, recommendation, or structural event is present; this is routine NAV disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
